critical_code_review_comments: Admin endpoints authenticate via a shared static header (X-Admin-Secret). Fine for demo, but recommend rotating out of default 'sorayaco-admin' in production and moving to per-admin JWT + audit log for /api/admin/products PATCH.

seed_products() force-reseeds products whenever oversize-blouse-motif image equals the placeholder. Once real images are in place this is a no-op, but an admin who edits the cover to the placeholder URL would trigger a full re-seed on next restart and lose all admin edits. Consider gating on a schema version flag stored in a `meta` collection.

PATCH /api/admin/products/{id} accepts `image` as any string with no validation. A malicious admin could set image to javascript: or an off-origin tracker. Restrict to /api/media/... or https:// with allow-list.
Deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown still in server.py (carried over from iteration 1 & 2). Migrate to lifespan context manager.
/api/checkout/success still marks order paid via GET without Stripe webhook verification (carried over). OK for emergent test key, unsafe for prod.
seed_data_creation: None. Admin round-trip test reverts blouse-kancing-depan to price=89000, categories=['blouse']. Verified idempotency both via pytest and via UI-driven flow.

Admin secret = 'sorayaco-admin' via X-Admin-Secret header (also stored in browser localStorage key 'sorayaco_admin_secret' after successful unlock — clear it via `window.localStorage.removeItem('sorayaco_admin_secret')` before testing gate). Media served from /api/media/product/TRM-004-{1..35}.jpg and /api/media/category/{atasan,blouse,tunik-rayon,gamis-maxy,midi-dress,setelan,best-seller,pyajamas}.jpg + {promo,reseller}.png.
